customer_janeway: Hey team — we're seeing SSE responses cut off mid-stream when traffic goes through Cloudflare -> ALB -> nginx. Client shows partial last event and then a reconnect 502. Repro below, it's consistent ~30s after first chunk.

alex_support: Ouch. Can you paste the exact curl + headers and any proxy/nginx conf? Also which ALB idle timeout?

customer_janeway: Curl we used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=gpt-neo"
```
Behavior: initial chunks come through, then silence, client reconnects and gets a 502 from ALB. No obvious errors in app logs.

maya_sre: Do you have Cloudflare in front? CF sometimes coalesces h2 connections and suppresses keepalive probes. Also ALB default idle is 60s — what is yours?

customer_janeway: Yes CF (managed), ALB idle is 60s, nginx proxy_read_timeout 65s, proxy_buffering on. Client doesn't send heartbeat.

eric_prod: We saw a cluster of similar reports today from customers behind CF+ALB. It often ends up being a combination: CF HTTP/2 + ALB/LB halfclose race + origin nginx buffering the trailing chunk until upstream FIN. Quick repro: add a client-side SSE heartbeat every 15s and set `proxy_buffering off` — see if it stabilizes.

customer_janeway: Trying quick change now. Also attaching a trimmed pcap/tcpdump: last FIN observed from origin at ~30s and the client sees a truncated final chunk. Server logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:30Z] conn=abcd read=2048 write=2048 event=keepalive_idle
[2026-03-15T14:02:59Z] upstream=closed halfclose
```

alex_support: Two actionable checks: (1) disable nginx gzip/proxy_buffering and set `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection "";` to avoid unexpected connection semantics, (2) enable SSE heartbeat (a comment line `:hb

` or short event every 10-15s) to keep intermediate proxies from idling.

maya_sre: Also try `sendfile off; tcp_nopush off;` on nginx if you see coalesced packets. ALB health/idle settings + CF proxy timeouts can cause midstream halfclose; heartbeats mitigate.

customer_janeway: I disabled proxy_buffering + added a client heartbeat every 15s. Ran 6 local tests — all completed without truncation. Rolling change to prod in a minute.

eric_prod: Good sign. For our KB and engineering follow-ups: (a) document CF->ALB->nginx interaction, (b) recommend default SSE heartbeat 15s and example nginx snippets, (c) consider server-side detection of truncated final event and automatic non-stream fallback.

alex_support: Created ticket SUP-20260315-132 and attached logs + pcap. Customer will confirm after prod rollout.

deploy_bot: deploy: staging nginx-proxy config update (disable proxy_buffering + 15s heartbeat) — deploy id 20260315-22 :white_check_mark:

customer_janeway: Prod rollout complete, initial checks show streams stable. Marking resolved, will reopen if it reappears. Thanks! :tada:

maya_sre: Nice — let's add a synthetic monitor for CF->ALB->nginx SSE end-to-end to catch regressions.

alex_support: Adding KB entry under support/streaming with nginx snippet examples and Cloudflare notes. Closing thread for now.
